title: Vanilla Almond Rye Porridge with Blueberries
blurb: Nutty rye flakes simmered in vanilla almondmilk until creamy, topped with honey, toasted almonds and fresh blueberries.
steps: Put the rye flakes, almondmilk, water and salt in a medium saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the flakes are tender and the mixture is thick and creamy.
While the porridge cooks, toast the sliced almonds in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, tossing frequently, until golden and fragrant.
Divide the porridge between four bowls and drizzle each with honey.
Top each bowl with toasted almonds and blueberries, then serve warm.
